title: Golden Joystick Awards 2026 (44th, held Wed 11 Nov 2026; mostly fan-voted): Resident Evil Requiem (Capcom) wins Ultimate Game of the Year with 17% of the public vote, one point ahead of Phantom Blade Zero (16%), Crimson Desert third (Insider Gaming, TheGamer); Requiem's four awards: Ultimate GOTY, Console GOTY (27%), Best Game Trailer, Best Lead Performer (Angela Sant'Albano as Grace Ashcroft); Capcom Studio of the Year (57%); Onimusha: Way of the Sword Best Audio Design; Crimson Desert PC GOTY; Dispatch Storytelling + Soundtrack; Big Walk Critics' Choice; The Witcher 4 Most Wanted (TheGamer, Insider Gaming, Polygon); GTA 6 (out 19 Nov) not on the shortlist. Meccha Chameleon (self-published indie) also won four awards (Best Multiplayer Game, Best Indie Game – Self-published, Developers' Choice, Streamers' Choice), tying Requiem for most (TheGamer, Insider Gaming). Steam India prices checked 12 Nov ~02:00 IST: RE Requiem ₹4,399, Crimson Desert ₹4,499, Phantom Blade Zero ₹4,299, Dispatch ₹1,300, Big Walk ₹999, Meccha Chameleon ₹309 (no discounts).
